EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 2,112 Mn (+48% YoY/+8% QoQ); above our estimate of INR 2,048 Mn. EBITDA margin stood at 19.4% (+201bps YoY/+15bps QoQ) above our estimate of 19.1%.PAT stood at INR 1,104 Mn (+55% YoY/+26% QoQ); beating our estimate of INR 1,072 Mn. PAT Margin reported at 10.1% inline with our estimate of 10%. The positive trajectory in reported numbers are attributed to the high growth and margin ADS segment crossing 15% share in consolidated revenues. Concurrently, the core Automotive ICE vertical maintained robust volume growth. Investment Rationale Firm Order-Backed Capacity Buildout: To execute its expanding order pipeline, SEL upgraded its FY27 Capex plan to approximately INR 8,000 Mn(from INR 5,000 Mn). Facility expansions across Plant 9, a new 120,000 sqft. precision facility, and a dedicated Defense plant will create an incremental revenue capacity target of ~INR 35,000 Mn. As on Q2FY27 the non-ADS order book recorded at peak annual revenue indicating robust ordering activity. ADS Mix to aid Margin Expansion: Sansera's Aerospace, Defence, and Semiconductor (ADS) segment has transformed into the primary growth driver. Capitalizing on global supply chain alignments toward Indian manufacturing hubs and new SKU approvals, ADS revenue expanded 206% YoY in Q2FY27 to INR 1,643 Mn. Supported by an unexecuted 5-year backlog of INR 58,697 Mn and incremental asset turns (2x), the vertical continue to provide high-margin and revenue visibility. Capex to Support Order Execution: SEL plans for a capex of INR ~8,000 Mn(earlier INR 5,000 Mn) in FY27 across forging, machining and ADS facilities,. The 80,000 sqft Aero/SEM hangar, surface-treatment facility and additional crankshaft and connecting-rod capacity should support execution of the growing order pipeline. Further, the 60:40 Nichidai JV will further expand orders in cold and warm-forged precision components and increase exposure to technology-agnostic applications. Capacity expansion remains critical given the expanding order pipeline. 50% of the capex is dedicated towards the ADS vertical. We believe this capex trajectory can relieve increasing order backlog over FY27-29E. Structural Market Share Expansion in Core Auto: The Auto ICE segment continues to outperform industry growth underlying vehicle production through OEM supplier consolidation and increased outsourcing, growing 18.2% YoY in Q2FY27. Simultaneously, Auto Tech-Agnostic and xEV revenues grew 27% YoY, driving higher content-per-vehicle as electrification and premiumization take hold. Outlook and valuation We project revenue of INR 51,388 Mn/INR 61,653 Mn with EBITDA margins of 20.1%/20.7% in FY28E/FY29E. EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 reported at 19.4% (viz 17.3% YoY) primarily on the back of an increasing ADS mix. Our medium-long term outlook remains positive, driven by rapid scaling of the ADS segment. Growth visibility is supported by an unexecuted ADS backlog of INR 58,697 Mn, executable over ~5 years and capex aimed to execute the the same coupled with management’s FY27 ADS revenue guidance of INR 5,500-6,000 Mn. We expect margin expansion going forward as the share of high-margin ADS and non-ICE businesses increases. Capacity additions including the 45,000 sqft defence plant, Pantnagar Plant 16 and the Nichidai JV further strengthen the company’s positioning in precision- engineered and tech-agnostic components. Despite elevated CapEx to support future growth, the balance sheet remains comfortable with net debt/equity at ~0.7x, with asset turn for ADS being 2-2.2 times. Overall, order visibility, improving business mix and order execution across high-growth segments support healthy earnings trajectory. We value SEL at 45x FY29E EPS of ~INR 113.8, implying a target price of INR 5,123 and retain our HOLD rating.
